Package org.springframework.web.servlet

@NullMarked package org.springframework.web.servlet
Provides servlets that integrate with the application context infrastructure, and the core interfaces and classes for the Spring web MVC framework.

本包及相关包在 Rod Johnson 所著的《Expert One-On-One J2EE Design and Development》（Wrox，2002）第 12 章和第 13 章中进行了讨论。 Expert One-On-One J2EE Design and Development
